title: Geophysical and Geotechnical Methods for Diagnosing Flood Protection Dikes
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes

Although the principles of the method described herein were developed on dikes in France, they may be applied with confidence to flood protection dikes and levees in other countries around the world. Phase one of the methodology involves gathering as much information as possible about the dike from archive analysis, interviews with managers and inspections of the structures. This phase is essential in ensuring the high quality of the final diagnosis.
